description: Asset-scoped success/failure callbacks. Prefect's @task(on_completion=..., on_failure=...) — Dagster's built-in hooks are job-scoped; this component gives you asset-scoped hooks as ordinary `mod:fn` refs. on_success called with (context, result); on_failure called with (context, exception). Callback exceptions are logged, not re-raised — hooks never change the compute's outcome (matches Prefect semantics). Companion `@on_hooks` decorator.

outputs.description: One @dg.asset. Success/failure callbacks fire AFTER compute completes. Metadata: n_success_hooks, n_failure_hooks.

asset_name.description: Dagster asset name. Required when NOT using `wraps:` (inherited from inner in wraps mode).
asset_name.label: Asset Name

on_success.label: On Success
on_success.description: List of 'mod:fn' refs called with (context, result).

on_failure.label: On Failure
on_failure.description: List of 'mod:fn' refs called with (context, exception).

name: Hooks Asset
